notes.title: Unmasking 666
notes.content:
[h2]🔥🌆 Hey there, hustlers of the "Narco Wars" underworld! 🔥🌆[/h2]

Introducing... "666", a chilling FPS game that seamlessly blends action-packed gameplay reminiscent of classic shooters with haunting horror elements. Dive deep into the abyss and face formidable foes as you venture through eerie government sites, horrifying underground labs, and even the treacherous realms of Hell itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/e3cd1d7dd60a820ad3b590b97ed70d6e5324ab5e.png[/img]

[h2]💥 Key Features of "666" 💥[/h2]

    Retro FPS Action
    Chilling Horror Atmosphere
    Epic Battles with Demonic Overlords
    Competitive Leaderboards
    Regular Updates

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/ee29a2d3a17c1feb9c581ae015bdbf65e5f8de32.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/3d783424998185862aa65cc3dcd0b1eede17a2b7.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/9f40b8d26b3e210afff4b1f4ca28d9ec632395f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/5ecd2b3e6e2a8c56527db5e612813fbbdc07ad18.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/dc73965c14d0b409ae447c83e4810905ae297913.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/6fea69d0cff72e49a9d85dc4328c5625a68998ba.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/3d0bf46a06653897f1d1e2a7a1a45c126010bb3a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/b238cd01917744bbdd7b0c0dc5ea90e29ca6bd0a.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/4ba68a4818dab53224e739e32979cfaedb8bad36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/295a8a11c1327b28370c5457c732c228cfe89b34.png[/img][/url]

Just as you'll master the art of the hustle in the Big Apple, prepare to wield traditional weaponry and arcane powers in a darker realm. From close combat with the trusty Kukri to long-range devastation with the Rocket Launcher, the choice is yours.

Targeted Release: Q1 2026 🔜 Mark your calendars!

🎮 And the best part? "666" has its page up on Steam now! 🎮

If you've loved the high-risk, high-reward lifestyle of "Narco Wars" and crave more adrenaline-packed experiences, "666" is right up your alley. You thought NY's drug trade was brutal? Wait till you face the Demon King.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593030/666/]Wishlist "666" NOW[/url] on Steam and be the first to descend into the abyss when it drops. Remember, just like in the streets of NY, it's kill or be killed.

notes.title: Awesome Launch! 500+ wishlists
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Hustlers! 💰[/h1]

First off, a MASSIVE thank you to everyone for the insane support during our launch. With a whopping 502 wishlists in just three days, it's clear that there's a whole lot of you ready to take on the challenge and dominate the NY drug trade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484514/ce4282a1ae296f67a840e1cfc42f592545c76d16.png[/img]

[h2]What's the Hype All About?[/h2]
Narco Wars is a unique turn-based drug economy simulator that immerses you in the dark underbelly of 90s New York's drug scene. With only $2k to your name and a lucrative drug trade spread out before you, the question lingers: do you have the strategic prowess and moral flexibility to build an empire in just a month?

[h2]Massive announcements soon![/h2]
We've got things in the pipeline so big that we can't even tell you yet. Trust us, you don't want to miss out. [b]Press the Wishlist button to stay in the loop![/b]

Stay shady,
The Narco Wars Team
